messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Translate literally: Flatey býður upp á kyrrð og ró, fallega fjallasýn á Flateyjarskaga, víðáttu og ilm af hafinu. Þar er alltaf gott veður. Færir mann aftur til fortíðar þar sem þurfti að hafa aðeins meira fyrir lífinu.

message.content: Flatey offers quiet and peace, beautiful mountain views on the Flateyjarskagi, spaciousness, and the scent of the sea. There is always good weather there. Returning a person to the past there where one needed to have only more for life.
